description: Polar is a payments, billing, and merchant-of-record platform for selling software, subscriptions, and digital products. It provides hosted billing primitives, customer management, checkout flows, and related commerce infrastructure.
summary: Polar exposes a REST HTTP API at api.polar.sh/v1 (covering both core and customer-portal operations), two remote MCP endpoints at mcp.polar.sh for production and sandbox, and a Polar CLI for webhook-local-development workflows.
